title: HB 2077 (2009-2010 Regular Session (2009)): AN ACT concerning elections; amending K.S.A. 2008 Supp. 25-1122, 25-1123, 25-2908 and 25-3002 and repealing the existing sections.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) K.S.A. 25-2908(i)(1) as amended (As Amended by House Committee)
(quote) The following forms of identification shall be considered current and valid if such form of identification contains the name and photograph of the applicant, the applicant’s signature and an expiration date which has not expired:
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) K.S.A. 25-2908(i)(2)
(quote) If the voter fails to furnish the identification required by this subsection, the voter shall be allowed to vote a provisional ballot. The canvassing board shall determine the validity of the ballot pursuant to K.S.A. 25-3002 and amendments thereto.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) K.S.A. 25-1122(c)
(quote) (c) If the registered voter is applying for an advance voting ballot to be transmitted by mail, and such voter is a first-time voter, such voter shall provide on the application for an advance voting ballot the voter’s current and valid Kansas driver’s license number, nondriver’s identification card number or the last four digits of the voter’s social security number, or shall provide with the application a copy of the voter’s current and valid Kansas driver’s license, nondriver’s identification card, utility bill, bank statement, paycheck, government check or other government document containing the voter’s current name and address as indicated on the registration book.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1 (effective date of photo ID rules)
(quote) From and after January 1, 2012, K.S.A.
(other) K.S.A. 25-1122, 25-1123 (advance voting ID); 25-2908 (photographic ID at the polls from January 1, 2012); 25-3002 (canvass of provisional ballots).
